usedFor: vPlan holds cards and comments, LeadConnector holds contacts, and “New or Updated Card” can feed “Create Or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New or Updated Card” in vPlan, then “Add or Remove Contact from Workflow” in LeadConnector
bestTemplate.why: A new or updated card adds or removes a contact from a LeadConnector workflow by ID or email.

watchOut: “New or Updated Card” fires on updates too, so “Create Contact” can run more than once for one card.
